name: Air Quality
description: Hear the air quality index, fine particles (PM2.5 and PM10) and the UV index where you are, with a short tip for the category, and see the next hours and days. It uses your main place from Preferences, Places, or another place or a city you choose in Preferences, Air Quality. Air quality data by Open-Meteo.com (CAMS; no account or API key needed).
author: Rafli
